notes.title: Epochal Update: Welcome Unreal Engine 5 and Numerous Enhancements!
notes.content:
We've worked diligently on your game, and here's what we've prepared for you:

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs.
[*] Added random object spawns for more interaction.
[*] Doors now work instantly.
[*] Balanced the game for a better experience.
[*] Guided you on the right path with in-game tips.
[*] Enhanced the bots to make them even smarter.
[*] Translated the game to Unreal Engine 5 for incredible graphics.
[*] Optimized graphics for smooth gameplay and much more.
[*] Enjoy the updated game!
[/list]

At present, we are diligently crafting a brand-new map, and this creative endeavor is anything but swift. We're pouring our time and dedication into perfecting every detail, ensuring that it exceeds your expectations.
